subject_notes: Multi-PE electronic warfare, comms, SDA Tracking Layer prime, Aerojet Rocketdyne acquisition (2023). Now restructured into SMS / CSD / MSL segments (fiscal 2026).
parent_thesis: L3Harris is the 'Trusted Disruptor' merchant supplier prime: software-defined tactical comms, ISR, EW, space payloads, and missile/propulsion (Aerojet Rocketdyne). Builds end-to-end defense tech across air/space/land/sea/cyber, 75% U.S. Government revenue, with rollups (Aerojet 2023, TDL 2023) intended to add propulsion + datalink IP.

claims.claim_text: U.S. Government customer revenue (direct + prime + FMS) was 75% of fiscal 2025 revenue (76% in 2024 and 2023). Implies multi-billion-dollar federal contract footprint with DoW.
claims.subject: L3Harris Technologies, Inc.
claims.object_value: 75% USG / FY2025; total FY2025 segment revenue ~$22.1B (CS $5,673M + IMS $6,630M + SAS $6,946M + AR $2,845M)

claims.claim_text: Named as PRP at 113 sites under Superfund / CERCLA / RCRA, with estimated environmental liability of $659M as of Jan 2, 2026 ($637M prior year). Large environmental footprint consistent with legacy aerospace/defense manufacturing.
claims.subject: L3Harris Technologies, Inc.
claims.source_quote: As of January 2, 2026, we were named, and continue to be named, as a PRP at 113 sites, including 12 sites owned by us, 73 sites associated with our current and former operations and 28 hazardous waste treatment, storage or disposal facility sites... Our estimated liability associated with these identified sites was $659 million and $637 million as of January 2, 2026 and January 3, 2025, respectively.
